programs.title: Phantom Signals
programs.desc: Experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate a mysterious phenomenon at the tomb of a 3,000-year-old Egyptian pharaoh.

programs.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programs.sub_title: Mummy Medicine, King of Poisons, Maya Sweat Baths
programs.desc: Macabre cures, toxic tonics and Mayan healing rituals reveal medicine's wild past.

programs.title: Colossal Machines
programs.desc: Since the dawn of time, humans have braved the tides and waves, navigating one of the most powerful forces on earth; taking a look inside the cutting-edge technology that broke the barriers to extreme water travel.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: The search for Janet Mae Johnson, the missing mountaineer from 1973, takes a new turn with the discovery of her backpack and camera in 2020, raising new questions about her tragic fate.

programs.title: Nazis: Threads of Evil
programs.desc: A loyal Nazi and a paramilitary leader, Ernst Rohm, comes to the forefront alongside Hitler; once one of his closest allies, Rohm's openly gay identity, radical beliefs and growing power make him both indispensable and dangerous to the Nazi regime.

programs.title: Secret Societies: In the Shadows
programs.desc: Yale's ultra-secret society is a pinnacle of the elite, and its members have become Presidents, Supreme Court Justices, and heads of industry; to be "tapped" is to be welcomed into a line of power brokers with the promise of life-long opportunities.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: One last push for signs of the lost Viking as the Fara Heim crew embarks on their most ambitious mission yet. With Mack's departure, the remaining members of the team come across a site that is unquestionably human made. But is this the site they are looking for? Time is running out as this season finale looks to rewrite the history books.

programs.title: Nintendo 64 Quest
programs.desc: Jay and Rob travel to Indiana to meet up with an old friend in hopes of solving their newly discovered problem.

programs.title: The Animal Within
programs.desc: The human species has long admired strength and power; while people push beyond their own physical capabilities, using science and technology, the animal kingdom has evolved their bodies to achieve things that humans simply dream of.

programs.title: Fishing for History
programs.desc: The Boys journey to Magnet fishing Mecca Voorhaven in the Netherlands, also home to windmills, tulips and canals filled with World War 2 weaponry waiting to be pulled from its murky depths.

programs.title: Disaster Deja vu
programs.desc: In 1939 and again in 2009, Australia watches helplessly as massive firestorms roar through bone-dry forests with devastating speed; monstrous earthquakes below sea level bring untold misery and devastation to Haiti in 1842 and 2010.

programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Georgia's mother parted from her parents in Greece on bad terms at only sixteen years old. Now, Georgia is desperate to connect with her Greek heritage and to have a better relationship with her own mother.
